competitive_position.basis: stated directly in P1 and P3 (and summarized in P2)
competitive_position.claim: Because REIT tax rules prohibit Xenia from operating its hotels directly, it depends on third-party hotel managers whose poor execution or misaligned incentives could harm operating results.
quotes: To qualify as a REIT, the Company cannot operate or manage its hotels.

Our operating results could be materially and adversely affected if any of our third-party managers fail to provide quality services and amenities, or otherwise fail to manage our hotels in our best interest.

competitive_position.claim: Luxury and upper upscale hotels are more susceptible to revenue drops during recessions as guests shift to lower-cost alternatives, while largely fixed real estate and operating expenses magnify earnings downside.
quotes: Our portfolio consists of luxury and upper upscale hotels and resorts, and consumer preferences tend to shift to lower-cost alternatives during recessionary periods and other periods in which disposable income is adversely affected, which could lead to a decline in reservations and an increase in cancellations, and thus result in lower revenue.

We have also seen that, due to the mix of business, luxury and upper upscale hotels and resorts are more susceptible to a decrease in revenue, as compared to hotels in other categories that have lower room rates.

Many costs, such as real estate taxes, insurance premiums, maintenance costs and certain hotel operating costs generally are more fixed than variable and as a result, are not reduced even when a hotel is not fully occupied, when operations have been suspended, when room rates decrease or other circumstances cause a reduction in revenues.

competitive_position.basis: stated directly in P2 and P4
competitive_position.claim: Macroeconomic uncertainty, inflation in wages and renovation costs, trade disputes, interest-rate changes, and structural shifts toward virtual meetings or remote work threaten demand and margins.
quotes: We continue to monitor and evaluate the challenges associated with consumer confidence, inflationary pressures, changing interest rates, a potential domestic and/or global recession, global conflicts, trade disputes, and the evolving workforce and wage landscape.

Hotels, on the other hand, generate revenue from guests who typically stay at the hotel for only a few nights, which causes the room rates and occupancy levels at each of our hotels to change every day, and results in earnings that can be highly volatile.

quotes: “Our third quarter results significantly surpassed our expectations, as strong broad-based group and corporate transient demand coupled with an incremental increase in leisure demand from several large events drove substantial increases in Same-Property RevPAR, Same-Property Total RevPAR and Same-Property Hotel EBITDA compared to the same period last year,” said Marcel Verbaas, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Xenia.

quotes: Worsening of the U.S. or global economy would likely have an adverse impact on the occupancy, ADR and RevPAR of our hotels, and would therefore adversely impact our results of operations and financial condition.

Our portfolio consists of luxury and upper upscale hotels and resorts, and consumer preferences tend to shift to lower-cost alternatives during recessionary periods and other periods in which disposable income is adversely affected, which could lead to a decline in reservations and an increase in cancellations, and thus result in lower revenue.
Historically, business travelers have made up the majority of transient demand at our hotels.

We continue to believe our high-quality and well-located portfolio is well-positioned for future growth as we expect lodging demand for higher-end hotels and resorts to continue to be strong while supply growth remains limited for the foreseeable future.

quotes: Room rates and occupancy, and thus RevPAR, tend to increase when demand growth exceeds supply growth.

A reduction or slowdown in growth of lodging demand or increased growth in lodging supply could result in returns that are substantially below expectations or result in losses, which could materially and adversely affect our revenues and profitability as well as limit or slow our future growth and impact our ability to service our indebtedness and/or make distributions to stockholders.
In addition, travelers can book stays on websites that facilitate the short-term rental of homes and apartments from owners, thereby providing an alternative to hotel rooms.
